description: Extensible catalogue of review/validation questions used by the LATCH onboarding app's Reference → Questions table. Each entry pairs a question with the taxonomy node it is most relevant to and the onboarding phase it applies to, so questions can be filtered, grouped, or surfaced contextually alongside the taxonomy and onboarding flow they inform.

source.note: The initial 323 entries were extracted from the CISA Logging Reference Architecture (converted to Markdown in this repository). taxonomyCode/taxonomyTerm/onboardingPhase were assigned by editorial judgement at the (section, subsection) level, not verbatim from the source document -- treat them as a reasoned starting point, refine as needed.

onboardingPhases.description: Phase 1 -- is onboarding feasible, supportable and proportionate?
Is it worth building, and was it built and accepted correctly?
Does the parsed data clear the minimum bar to ingest?
Does it stay healthy, used and worth keeping?

howToAddQuestions: Append a new object to the `questions` array below. `id` should be the next unused Q### value (zero-padded, unique). `taxonomyCode` should be a real code from the taxonomy (Onboard Taxonomy tab) -- use the most specific node that fits, or a domain-level code (e.g. "TAX-03") if no more specific node exists yet. `onboardingPhase` must be one of the four values listed in `onboardingPhases` above. `section`/`subsection` are free text describing where the question comes from (a source document heading, a review checklist name, etc.) -- leave `subsection` as an empty string if the question has no finer-grained grouping. If no existing taxonomy node genuinely fits a question, use taxonomyCode "UNMAPPED" and a taxonomyTerm explaining why (e.g. "No current taxonomy node fits -- flagged for future taxonomy review") rather than forcing a loose match -- this is an intentional, explicit placeholder, not an error, and is excluded from the live-taxonomy verification check applied to every other code.
